Requirement: Registered user signs in with a valid username and password
SourceRequirement: FR-001 – User Login - The system shall allow registered users to log in using a valid username and password.
GapOrQualification: Password verification and session creation exist. Active-account enforcement is a separate missing requirement under FR-008/BR-001.
AcceptanceCheck: Valid registered credentials establish the expected role session; invalid credentials do not.

SourceRequirement: FR-002 – Credential Validation - The system shall validate the credentials entered by the user.
GapOrQualification: Empty credentials and invalid username/password combinations are rejected.
AcceptanceCheck: Empty, unknown-user, and wrong-password submissions are rejected without authentication.

SourceRequirement: FR-003 – Invalid Login Notification - The system shall display an appropriate error message when invalid credentials are entered.
GapOrQualification: Error is displayed in the automatically opened sign-in dialog; failed-login cooldown is also handled.
AcceptanceCheck: Invalid credentials reopen the sign-in popup and show an understandable error.

Requirement: Restrict functions according to assigned role
SourceRequirement: FR-004 – Role-Based Access - The system shall provide access to system functions according to the user’s assigned role.
GapOrQualification: Module-level authorization exists, but the alternate user-update path bypasses owner protection. Changed/revoked roles are not reloaded for existing sessions.
AcceptanceCheck: Try every protected page/API by role; prevent alternate owner-account update paths and enforce revoked roles in existing sessions.

Requirement: Allow authenticated users to log out
SourceRequirement: FR-005 – Logout - The system shall allow authenticated users to log out of the system.
GapOrQualification: Session data, cookie, and session are cleared.
AcceptanceCheck: Log out then revisit a protected page and API; neither may accept the old session.

SourceRequirement: FR-006 – Create User The administrator shall be able to create user accounts.
GapOrQualification: Creation and password hashing exist. Staff assignment has the separate FR-009 defect.
AcceptanceCheck: As administrator, create a user and confirm the saved account can authenticate with its assigned role.

SourceRequirement: FR-007 – Update User The administrator shall be able to update user account information.
GapOrQualification: Username, password, and role can be updated. Owner-account authorization must be corrected under FR-004.
AcceptanceCheck: Update username/password and verify saved values; leaving password blank preserves the existing password.

SourceRequirement: FR-008 – Disable User The administrator shall be able to deactivate a user account.
GapOrQualification: Existing operation deletes the row; there is no active/inactive status, deactivate action, or inactive-login rejection.
AcceptanceCheck: Deactivate an account, retain its history, reject new login, and invalidate its existing protected access.

SourceRequirement: FR-009 – Assign Role The administrator shall be able to assign a role to a user.
GapOrQualification: UI offers Staff, but the API's accepted role list and role migration exclude it.
AcceptanceCheck: Assign each offered role, including Staff, and verify API validation, persistence, navigation, and permissions agree.

SourceRequirement: FR-010 – View Users The administrator shall be able to view registered users.
GapOrQualification: A user list and table are implemented.
AcceptanceCheck: As administrator, view registered users; other roles cannot retrieve the protected user list.

SourceRequirement: FR-011 – Add Product Authorized users shall be able to add a new product.
GapOrQualification: Product/recipe save path exists. Some success/error notification calls reverse their arguments; see additional findings.
AcceptanceCheck: Create a valid product/recipe and verify it appears with correct price/category/ingredients.

SourceRequirement: FR-012 – Update Product Authorized users shall be able to update product information.
GapOrQualification: Product and recipe editing exist; notification defect also applies here.
AcceptanceCheck: Edit product/recipe and verify the persisted fields and ingredients match the edit.

SourceRequirement: FR-013 – Remove Product Authorized users shall be able to deactivate products that are no longer offered.
GapOrQualification: Product and ingredient rows are deleted instead of recording a discontinued/inactive state.
AcceptanceCheck: Deactivate a sold product without deleting its identity or transaction history.

SourceRequirement: FR-014 – View Products The system shall display the list of available products.
GapOrQualification: Lists exist, but list all product rows without an availability state/filter. Kiosk order submission does not check ingredient stock.
AcceptanceCheck: List orderable products and verify unavailable products are excluded or clearly disabled.

SourceRequirement: FR-015 – Product Availability The system shall allow authorized users to mark products as available or unavailable.
GapOrQualification: No availability field, update operation, UI control, or order-time availability enforcement.
AcceptanceCheck: Toggle product availability and reject unavailable products in direct kiosk/POS requests.

SourceRequirement: FR-016 – Create Order The cashier shall be able to create a new customer order.
GapOrQualification: Cashier cart creation and backend processing exist; payment requirements remain separate gaps.
AcceptanceCheck: As cashier, create a fresh cart, add products and quantities, and proceed to payment.

Requirement: Add one or more products to an order
SourceRequirement: FR-017 – Add Product to Order The cashier shall be able to add one or more products to an order.
GapOrQualification: Multiple products and positive integer quantities are supported.
AcceptanceCheck: Add multiple distinct products and repeated quantities; reject invalid product IDs and nonpositive/noninteger quantities.

SourceRequirement: FR-018 – Modify Order The cashier shall be able to modify an order before payment.
GapOrQualification: Ordinary POS cart edits exist, but retrieved kiosk edits are replaced with original saved items during checkout.
AcceptanceCheck: Edit ordinary and retrieved kiosk carts, then ensure saved sale and receipt match the displayed edited order.

Requirement: Remove an item from an unpaid order
SourceRequirement: FR-019 – Remove Product from Order The cashier shall be able to remove an item from an unpaid order.
GapOrQualification: Ordinary POS removal works in the cart; kiosk removals are discarded at checkout.
AcceptanceCheck: Remove an item from ordinary and retrieved kiosk carts; it must remain removed at checkout.

SourceRequirement: FR-020 – Calculate Order Total The system shall automatically calculate the total amount of the order.
GapOrQualification: Server calculates subtotals and total. The kiosk-edit defect can make the displayed cart differ from the saved sale.
AcceptanceCheck: Use known quantities/prices; verify subtotals/total on client and server, rejecting browser-price tampering.

SourceRequirement: FR-021 – Record Payment The cashier shall be able to record the amount paid by the customer.
GapOrQualification: No tender field, payment validation, or persisted paid amount.
AcceptanceCheck: Enter payment and verify the amount paid is recorded against the completed transaction.

SourceRequirement: FR-022 – Calculate Change The system shall automatically calculate the customer’s change.
GapOrQualification: No amount-paid minus total calculation or change display/storage.
AcceptanceCheck: For exact payment change is zero; for overpayment change equals paid amount minus total.

Requirement: Save the transaction after successful payment
SourceRequirement: FR-023 – Complete Transaction The system shall save the transaction after successful payment.
GapOrQualification: Sale, items, and inventory commit atomically, but payment is neither recorded nor validated before completion.
AcceptanceCheck: Insufficient/missing payment creates no completed sale or stock deduction; valid payment commits exactly once.

SourceRequirement: FR-024 – Generate Receipt The system shall generate a transaction receipt.
GapOrQualification: View Details displays a receipt-like summary with transaction ID, date, cashier, items, and total. Checkout does not present that receipt as part of UC-003 payment flow. The SRS allows displayed receipts; printing/download is not mandatory.
AcceptanceCheck: After successful payment, present a displayed transaction receipt with ID, date, items, and total; printing is optional under the SRS.

SourceRequirement: FR-025 – Transaction Number The system shall automatically generate a unique transaction number for each completed transaction.
GapOrQualification: Sale ID is generated by the database and displayed as the transaction number. Deployed database constraints were not inspected.
AcceptanceCheck: Complete two transactions and verify distinct database-backed transaction numbers and preserved history.

SourceRequirement: FR-026 – Add Inventory Item Authorized users shall be able to add inventory items.
GapOrQualification: Inventory creation validates name, positive quantity, and unit.
AcceptanceCheck: Create an inventory item with valid name/quantity/unit and confirm it appears in current stock.

SourceRequirement: FR-027 – Record Stock Addition The system shall allow users to record newly received stock.
GapOrQualification: Dedicated replenishment adds received quantity. It does not retain a separate stock-receipt/movement journal.
AcceptanceCheck: Receive stock and verify the new quantity equals old quantity plus received quantity.

SourceRequirement: FR-028 – Update Inventory The system shall update inventory quantities based on recorded transactions.
GapOrQualification: Recipe-based deduction uses locks, conditional updates, and rollback protection. End-to-end transaction behavior was not run.
AcceptanceCheck: Complete a sale and verify exact recipe deductions; reject insufficient stock and concurrent overdraw with full rollback.

SourceRequirement: FR-029 – View Inventory Authorized users shall be able to view current inventory levels.
GapOrQualification: Current quantity and unit are displayed.
AcceptanceCheck: View current inventory and reconcile displayed quantities/units against test records.

Requirement: Identify items at/below their minimum stock level
SourceRequirement: FR-030 – Identify Low Stock The system shall identify inventory items that have reached their minimum stock level.
GapOrQualification: Boundary comparison correctly uses <=, but minimum is hardcoded to 10 for all units/items. SRS section 10.3 defines an item Minimum Stock field; that field is absent from the model/form/schema supplied. If the owner explicitly approves a universal minimum of 10, this can be reclassified as implemented against that clarified policy.
AcceptanceCheck: For item-specific minimums, verify low-stock status at and below the threshold, and normal status above it.

Requirement: Sales transactions for a selected date
SourceRequirement: FR-031 – Daily Sales Report The system shall generate a report containing sales transactions for a selected date.
GapOrQualification: All-date transaction history exists, but no date selector/filter, selected-day aggregate total, or report print/export as required by AC-005.
AcceptanceCheck: Select a date and reconcile transaction rows and daily total; print/export the same selected result.

SourceRequirement: FR-032 – Weekly Sales Report The system shall generate a weekly sales report.
GapOrQualification: Current-week sales minus expenses is a net-profit chart, not a weekly sales report with period selection and transactions.
AcceptanceCheck: Select a week and reconcile its sales transactions/totals, including week-boundary dates.

SourceRequirement: FR-033 – Monthly Sales Report The system shall generate a monthly sales report.
GapOrQualification: Monthly expense summaries exist; monthly sales reporting does not.
AcceptanceCheck: Select a month and reconcile its sales transactions/totals, including month-boundary dates.

SourceRequirement: FR-034 – Product Sales Report The system shall generate a report showing sales by product.
GapOrQualification: Sale item details are stored, but no aggregate quantity/revenue by product report is implemented.
AcceptanceCheck: Generate product sales totals and quantities, reconciling them against sale items.

SourceRequirement: FR-035 – Inventory Report The system shall generate an inventory report.
GapOrQualification: Current inventory and low-stock information exist. UC-010's report-generation and print/export workflow is absent. Loading DataTables export libraries alone does not enable report controls.
AcceptanceCheck: Generate an inventory report with quantities/units/minima/status and print/export it.
